data.narrative:
Steady Energy is a Series G climate and energy company that has raised €32M to date across its funding lifecycle. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the narrow peer set at Steady Energy's stage and valuation tier contains insufficient datapoints for reliable median analysis.

Valuation triangulation relied on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using the €32M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a typical Series G step-up multiplier of 1.25x yields an implied valuation of €40M. This method assumes forward progression consistent with historical fundraising patterns for companies at this development stage and capital intensity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €34M to €46M, centered on €40M. The low end reflects near-term fundraising expectations, while the high end incorporates upside from successful execution. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage or similar-tier private comparables in Climate & Energy, limiting peer-derived anchoring. The reliance on a single method and the use of total raised as a proxy baseline rather than documented pre-money or post-money terms introduce material estimation risk. Further clarity on recent round terms and growth metrics would strengthen conviction in this range.
